FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_GlassFloatLine_TinPumpEdgeRoll
(*
 ====================================================================================================
  CYBER-PHYSICAL AUTOMATION ARCHITECTURE FOR CONTINUOUS FLOAT GLASS MANUFACTURING
  SUBSYSTEM : MOLTEN TIN BATH HYDRODYNAMICS & DROSS LINEAR INDUCTION PUMP (LIP)
              CROSS-DIRECTIONAL GLASS RIBBON THICKNESS PROFILING VIA TOP-ROLL KNURLING
  STANDARDS : IEC 61131-3 3rd Ed., ISA-88 Batch/Continuous States, ISO 13849-1 PL-d / SIL-2 Interlocks
 ====================================================================================================
  PROCESS PHYSICS CONTEXT:
  1. The float glass bath contains up to 200 metric tonnes of molten tin (Sn, melting pt 231.9 deg C)
     operating along a thermal gradient from 1050 deg C at the canal inlet to 600 deg C at the lehr exit.
  2. Natural equilibrium thickness of soda-lime glass floating on molten tin is governed by Laplace's
     interfacial tension balance: t_eq = 2 * SQRT( (gamma_glass + gamma_tin - gamma_interface) / (g * (rho_sn - rho_glass)) ) ~ 6.85 mm.
  3. Attenuating ribbon below 6.85 mm (e.g. 1.8 mm to 4.0 mm) requires positive toe-out knurl angles
     and longitudinal draw acceleration; producing thick plate (8.0 mm to 19.0 mm) requires negative
     toe-in damming angles.
  4. Atmospheric integrity (90-95% N2, 5-10% H2 at +3.0 to +10.0 mbar) prevents stannous/stannic oxide
     (SnO / SnO2) dross formation.
  5. The Linear Induction Pump (LIP) exerts traveling-wave Lorentz forces (J x B) on the molten tin
     surface to direct particulate dross into skimming weirs, avoiding ribbon entrapment.
 ====================================================================================================
*)

VAR_INPUT
    (* --- Master Supervisory and Functional Safety --- *)
    bSupervisoryEnable          : BOOL;     (* System master supervisory run enable [BOOL] *)
    bSafetyCircuitHealthy       : BOOL;     (* Redundant dual-channel hardwired safety relay status [BOOL] *)
    bKnurlRollPermissive        : BOOL;     (* Interlock permissive for top-roll penetration & engagement [BOOL] *)
    
    (* --- Kinematic & Glass Physical Inputs --- *)
    rLehrDrawSpeed_m_min        : REAL;     (* Lehr annealing entry draw linear velocity [m/min] *)
    rTargetNominalThickness_mm  : REAL;     (* Commanded recipe target glass thickness [mm] *)
    rMoltenTinCoreTemp_degC     : REAL;     (* Zone 4 molten tin core bulk temperature [deg C] *)
    rGlassRibbonViscosity_LogP  : REAL;     (* Calculated glass ribbon log10(dynamic viscosity) [Log Poise] *)
    
    (* --- Triple Modular Redundant (2oo3 TMR) Atmosphere Pressure --- *)
    rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar   : REAL;     (* Float chamber N2/H2 protective pressure transducer 1 [mbar] *)
    rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar   : REAL;     (* Float chamber N2/H2 protective pressure transducer 2 [mbar] *)
    rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar   : REAL;     (* Float chamber N2/H2 protective pressure transducer 3 [mbar] *)
    
    (* --- Linear Induction Pump (LIP) Stator Electrics & Thermals --- *)
    rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_U_A : REAL;     (* Traveling wave stator Phase U RMS current [A] *)
    rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_V_A : REAL;     (* Traveling wave stator Phase V RMS current [A] *)
    rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_W_A : REAL;     (* Traveling wave stator Phase W RMS current [A] *)
    rLIP_StatorWindingTemp_degC : REAL;     (* Embedded Pt100 stator core maximum hotspot temperature [deg C] *)
    rDrossCanalBedDepth_mm      : REAL;     (* Microwave radar dross accumulation bed thickness [mm] *)
    
    (* --- Laser Triangulation Optical Thickness Profiler Gauges --- *)
    rThicknessSensor_Left_mm    : REAL;     (* Left edge knurled ribbon margin measured thickness [mm] *)
    rThicknessSensor_Center_mm  : REAL;     (* Centerline optical laser measured thickness [mm] *)
    rThicknessSensor_Right_mm   : REAL;     (* Right edge knurled ribbon margin measured thickness [mm] *)
    bGaugeHealth_Left           : BOOL;     (* Left laser gauge optical signal validity & shutter OK [BOOL] *)
    bGaugeHealth_Center         : BOOL;     (* Center laser gauge optical signal validity & shutter OK [BOOL] *)
    bGaugeHealth_Right          : BOOL;     (* Right laser gauge optical signal validity & shutter OK [BOOL] *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    (* --- Line Status Words & Interlock Flags --- *)
    bFloatLineReady             : BOOL;     (* Float line thickness profiling and dross sweeping active [BOOL] *)
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode       : DWORD;    (* Bit-mapped 32-bit comprehensive diagnostic alarm register *)
    dwOperatingStatusWord       : DWORD;    (* Bit-mapped 32-bit state machine status & mode word *)
    bFailsafeRetractActive      : BOOL;     (* High-speed pneumatic top-roll roll-lift cylinders energized [BOOL] *)
    bDegradedControlMode        : BOOL;     (* Operating under degraded sensor / open-loop hold condition [BOOL] *)
    
    (* --- Linear Induction Pump Actuator Commands --- *)
    rLIP_InverterFreqCmd_Hz     : REAL;     (* Variable-frequency inverter synchronous stator excitation [Hz] *)
    rLIP_CurrentSetpointCmd_A   : REAL;     (* Magnetizing current amplitude setpoint [A] *)
    rTinSurfaceVelocity_m_s     : REAL;     (* Estimated molten tin surface flow velocity in dross canal [m/s] *)
    rDrossMassDischargeRate_kg_h: REAL;     (* Calculated continuous skimming mass throughput [kg/h] *)
    
    (* --- Top-Roll Kinematic Actuator Setpoints --- *)
    rLeftRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg   : REAL;     (* Left knurl gimbal toe angle command (positive = toe-out) [deg] *)
    rRightRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg  : REAL;     (* Right knurl gimbal toe angle command (positive = toe-out) [deg] *)
    rLeftRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min: REAL;     (* Left knurled wheel peripheral tangential velocity setpoint [m/min] *)
    rRightRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min:REAL;     (* Right knurled wheel peripheral tangential velocity setpoint [m/min] *)
    
    (* --- Arbitrated Physical Process Values --- *)
    rVotedBathPressure_mbar     : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR arbitrated mid-value bath pressure [mbar] *)
    rProfileThicknessError_mm   : REAL;     (* Estimated centerline glass ribbon thickness deviation [mm] *)
    rProfileAsymmetry_mm        : REAL;     (* Cross-directional ribbon thickness wedge asymmetry [mm] *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- Finite State Machine Execution Management --- *)
    iOperationState             : INT := 0; (* 0=INIT, 10=PURGE_VERIFY, 20=LIP_START, 30=KNURL_ENGAGE, 40=MPC_REGULATION, 50=DEGRADED, 99=ESTOP *)
    tStateTimer                 : TON;      (* State transition dwell and timeout monitor *)
    tDiscrepancyTimer_PT        : TON;      (* TMR pressure sensor discrepancy debouncing timer *)
    tStatorThermalWatchdog      : TON;      (* Stator over-temperature sustained alarm timer *)
    tKnurlSlewTimer             : TON;      (* Rate-of-change watchdog for roll positioning servos *)
    
    (* --- 2oo3 TMR Pressure Voting Registers --- *)
    bPT1_Valid                  : BOOL;
    bPT2_Valid                  : BOOL;
    bPT3_Valid                  : BOOL;
    rDelta_PT12                 : REAL;
    rDelta_PT23                 : REAL;
    rDelta_PT13                 : REAL;
    rTMR_Tolerance_mbar         : REAL := 0.65; (* Maximum tolerable divergence among sensors [mbar] *)
    
    (* --- Electromagnetic LIP Hydrodynamic Parameters --- *)
    rStatorPolePitch_m          : REAL := 0.180; (* Linear stator pole pitch tau_p [m] *)
    rSyncWaveVelocity_m_s       : REAL;          (* Electromagnetic wave velocity 2 * tau_p * f [m/s] *)
    rTinSlipFactor              : REAL;          (* Traveling wave slip s = (v_s - v_tin)/v_s *)
    rPhaseCurrentMean_A         : REAL;          (* 3-phase mean stator current [A] *)
    rPhaseCurrentUnbalance_pct  : REAL;          (* Stator current unbalance ratio [%] *)
    
    (* --- Viscoelastic Glass Attenuation & Knurl Kinematics --- *)
    rEquilibriumGlassThick_mm   : REAL := 6.85;  (* Natural Laplace equilibrium sheet thickness [mm] *)
    rAttenuationRatio           : REAL;          (* Ratio: rTargetNominalThickness_mm / 6.85 mm *)
    rKinematicNominalToe_deg    : REAL;          (* Base toe angle from steady-state drawing equations [deg] *)
    rToeLimitMax_deg            : REAL := 18.5;  (* Mechanical maximum toe-out gimbal limit [deg] *)
    rToeLimitMin_deg            : REAL := -6.5;  (* Mechanical maximum toe-in damming gimbal limit [deg] *)
    rBaseRollOverdrawRatio      : REAL := 1.018; (* Baseline peripheral overspeed factor to prevent ribbon wave *)
    
    (* --- Discrete-Time State-Space & Observer Matrices (Ts = 100 ms) --- *)
    (* State Vector: x = [1: Left Thickness Error (mm), 2: Right Thickness Error (mm), 3: Tin Surface Velocity (m/s)] *)
    matA                        : ARRAY[1..3, 1..3] OF REAL; (* Discrete state transition matrix A *)
    matB                        : ARRAY[1..3, 1..2] OF REAL; (* Control input coupling matrix B *)
    vecL                        : ARRAY[1..3] OF REAL;       (* Luenberger observer / steady Kalman gain L *)
    vecStateEstimate            : ARRAY[1..3] OF REAL;       (* State estimate vector x_hat *)
    vecPredictedState           : ARRAY[1..3] OF REAL;       (* Projected state vector x(k+1) *)
    vecMeasurementResidual      : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL;       (* Innovation residuals y_meas - C * x_hat *)
    vecControlIncrement_MPC     : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL;       (* Optimal control increment [delta_angle, delta_speed] *)
    
    (* --- MPC Weighting Penalties & Slew Constraints --- *)
    rCostWeight_Thickness       : REAL := 140.0; (* Penalty weight on thickness tracking deviation *)
    rCostWeight_Asymmetry       : REAL := 185.0; (* Penalty weight on cross-directional wedge profile *)
    rCostWeight_AngleSlew       : REAL := 18.0;  (* Penalty weight on knurl toe servo movement *)
    rCostWeight_SpeedSlew       : REAL := 12.0;  (* Penalty weight on knurl roll motor acceleration *)
    rMaxDeltaAngle_per_cycle    : REAL := 0.25;  (* Maximum permissible roll toe angle increment per 100ms [deg] *)
    rMaxDeltaSpeed_per_cycle    : REAL := 0.20;  (* Maximum permissible roll speed increment per 100ms [m/min] *)
    
    (* --- Internal Computation Iterators & Temporaries --- *)
    idxRow                      : INT;
    idxCol                      : INT;
    rAccumulator                : REAL;
    rRawDeltaToe                : REAL;
    rRawDeltaSpeed              : REAL;
    rMaxCurrentTemp             : REAL;
    rMinCurrentTemp             : REAL;
END_VAR

(*
 ====================================================================================================
  ALARM BIT DEFINITIONS (dwDiagnosticFaultCode):
  Bit 00 : Redundant Emergency Stop Safety Circuit Tripped
  Bit 01 : Bath Atmosphere PT1 Divergence / Hardware Fault
  Bit 02 : Bath Atmosphere PT2 Divergence / Hardware Fault
  Bit 03 : Bath Atmosphere PT3 Divergence / Hardware Fault
  Bit 04 : Critical Multi-Channel Atmosphere Divergence (All 3 Sensors Disagree)
  Bit 05 : Severe Protective Atmosphere Underpressure (< 2.2 mbar - Explosion/Oxidation Hazard)
  Bit 06 : Linear Induction Pump 3-Phase Current Unbalance Exceeds 12%
  Bit 07 : Linear Induction Pump Stator Winding Thermal Overload (> 160 deg C)
  Bit 08 : Optical Gauge Left Channel Invalid / Beam Interrupted
  Bit 09 : Optical Gauge Right Channel Invalid / Beam Interrupted
  Bit 10 : Optical Gauge Total Blackout (Left, Center, and Right Gauges Lost)
  Bit 11 : Molten Tin Bath Bulk Temperature Out-Of-Envelope (< 780 deg C or > 1080 deg C)
  Bit 12 : Finished Glass Thickness Tolerance Violation (+/- 0.85 mm Nominal Deviation)
  Bit 13 : Severe Cross-Directional Wedge Asymmetry (> 0.50 mm Difference)
 ====================================================================================================
*)

(*
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SECTION 1: HARD SAFETY & CRITICAL SUPERVISORY INTERLOCK CHECK
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
IF NOT bSafetyCircuitHealthy THEN
    bFloatLineReady              := FALSE;
    bFailsafeRetractActive       := TRUE;  (* Energize pneumatic lifters to immediately retract rolls *)
    rLIP_InverterFreqCmd_Hz      := 0.0;   (* De-energize linear induction pump stator *)
    rLIP_CurrentSetpointCmd_A    := 0.0;
    rLeftRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg    := 0.0;   (* Center roll gimbals *)
    rRightRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg   := 0.0;
    rLeftRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min := 0.0;
    rRightRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min:= 0.0;
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode        := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0001;
    dwOperatingStatusWord        := 16#0000_0099;
    iOperationState              := 99;    (* Hard Failsafe State *)
    RETURN;
ELSE
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode        := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_0001;
END_IF;

IF NOT bSupervisoryEnable THEN
    bFloatLineReady              := FALSE;
    bFailsafeRetractActive       := TRUE;
    rLIP_InverterFreqCmd_Hz      := 0.0;
    rLIP_CurrentSetpointCmd_A    := 0.0;
    rLeftRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg    := 0.0;
    rRightRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg   := 0.0;
    rLeftRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min := 0.0;
    rRightRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min:= 0.0;
    dwOperatingStatusWord        := 16#0000_0000;
    iOperationState              := 0;     (* Reset to uninitialized state *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(*
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SECTION 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) ATMOSPHERE PRESSURE ARBITRATION
  Maintains positive pressure barrier against ambient air back-draft into 90% N2 / 10% H2 atmosphere.
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
rDelta_PT12 := ABS(rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar - rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar);
rDelta_PT23 := ABS(rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar - rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar);
rDelta_PT13 := ABS(rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar - rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar);

bPT1_Valid := (rDelta_PT12 <= rTMR_Tolerance_mbar) OR (rDelta_PT13 <= rTMR_Tolerance_mbar);
bPT2_Valid := (rDelta_PT12 <= rTMR_Tolerance_mbar) OR (rDelta_PT23 <= rTMR_Tolerance_mbar);
bPT3_Valid := (rDelta_PT13 <= rTMR_Tolerance_mbar) OR (rDelta_PT23 <= rTMR_Tolerance_mbar);

(* Clear transient sensor divergence bits *)
dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_001E;

IF bPT1_Valid AND bPT2_Valid AND bPT3_Valid THEN
    (* All channels fully coherent: Select exact median value *)
    IF (rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar >= rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar AND rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar <= rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar) OR
       (rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar <= rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar AND rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar >= rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar) THEN
        rVotedBathPressure_mbar := rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar;
    ELSIF (rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar >= rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar AND rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar <= rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar) OR
          (rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar <= rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar AND rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar >= rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar) THEN
        rVotedBathPressure_mbar := rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar;
    ELSE
        rVotedBathPressure_mbar := rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar;
    END_IF;
ELSIF NOT bPT1_Valid AND bPT2_Valid AND bPT3_Valid THEN
    (* Sensor 1 isolated: Compute mean of remaining validated channels 2 and 3 *)
    rVotedBathPressure_mbar := (rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar + rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar) * 0.5;
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode   := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0002;
ELSIF NOT bPT2_Valid AND bPT1_Valid AND bPT3_Valid THEN
    (* Sensor 2 isolated: Compute mean of remaining validated channels 1 and 3 *)
    rVotedBathPressure_mbar := (rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar + rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar) * 0.5;
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode   := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0004;
ELSIF NOT bPT3_Valid AND bPT1_Valid AND bPT2_Valid THEN
    (* Sensor 3 isolated: Compute mean of remaining validated channels 1 and 2 *)
    rVotedBathPressure_mbar := (rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar + rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar) * 0.5;
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode   := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0008;
ELSE
    (* Triple Disagreement / Sensor Failure: Take minimum reading for failsafe conservatism *)
    rVotedBathPressure_mbar := MIN(MIN(rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar, rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar), rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar);
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode   := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0010;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate safety atmosphere seal threshold: Min 2.2 mbar *)
tDiscrepancyTimer_PT(IN := (rVotedBathPressure_mbar < 2.20), PT := T#2S);
IF tDiscrepancyTimer_PT.Q THEN
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0020;
    bFloatLineReady       := FALSE;
ELSE
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_0020;
END_IF;

(*
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SECTION 3: LINEAR INDUCTION PUMP (LIP) TRAVELING WAVE FLUID DYNAMICS
  Generates traveling sinusoidal magnetic field to sweep molten tin dross away from ribbon edges.
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
(* Stator 3-Phase Symmetrical Balance Calculation *)
rPhaseCurrentMean_A := (rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_U_A + rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_V_A + rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_W_A) / 3.0;
rMaxCurrentTemp     := MAX(MAX(rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_U_A, rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_V_A), rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_W_A);
rMinCurrentTemp     := MIN(MIN(rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_U_A, rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_V_A), rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_W_A);

IF rPhaseCurrentMean_A > 2.0 THEN
    rPhaseCurrentUnbalance_pct := ((rMaxCurrentTemp - rMinCurrentTemp) / rPhaseCurrentMean_A) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rPhaseCurrentUnbalance_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rPhaseCurrentUnbalance_pct > 12.0 THEN
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0040;
ELSE
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_0040;
END_IF;

(* Stator Winding Thermal Protection *)
tStatorThermalWatchdog(IN := (rLIP_StatorWindingTemp_degC > 160.0), PT := T#3S);
IF tStatorThermalWatchdog.Q THEN
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode     := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0080;
    rLIP_CurrentSetpointCmd_A := 55.0; (* Derate current command to prevent stator burnout *)
ELSE
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode     := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_0080;
    (* Current demand scaled linearly with radar-measured dross bed accumulation *)
    rLIP_CurrentSetpointCmd_A := 95.0 + (rDrossCanalBedDepth_mm * 18.5);
    IF rLIP_CurrentSetpointCmd_A > 180.0 THEN
        rLIP_CurrentSetpointCmd_A := 180.0; (* Inverter saturation clamp *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Synchronous electromagnetic linear wave velocity: v_s = 2 * tau_p * f *)
rSyncWaveVelocity_m_s := 2.0 * rStatorPolePitch_m * rLIP_InverterFreqCmd_Hz;
IF rSyncWaveVelocity_m_s > 0.05 THEN
    rTinSlipFactor := (rSyncWaveVelocity_m_s - vecStateEstimate[3]) / rSyncWaveVelocity_m_s;
ELSE
    rTinSlipFactor := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Compute physical molten tin surface velocity and dross removal mass flow rate *)
rTinSurfaceVelocity_m_s      := vecStateEstimate[3];
(* Mass flow = width * depth * density * velocity * packing factor (SnO2 rho ~ 6950 kg/m3) *)
rDrossMassDischargeRate_kg_h := vecStateEstimate[3] * 0.380 * (rDrossCanalBedDepth_mm * 0.001) * 6950.0 * 3600.0 * 0.15;

(*
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SECTION 4: TOP-ROLL KNURLING KINEMATICS & VISCOELASTIC ATTENUATION
  Applies balancing forces to hot glass ribbon against natural equilibrium (6.85 mm).
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
IF rEquilibriumGlassThick_mm > 0.1 THEN
    rAttenuationRatio := rTargetNominalThickness_mm / rEquilibriumGlassThick_mm;
ELSE
    rAttenuationRatio := 1.0;
END_IF;

(*
  Kinematic toe angle equation based on viscosity:
  Thin glass (<6.85 mm): Attenuation < 1.0 -> (1 - ratio) > 0 -> Positive toe-out angle (stretches ribbon)
  Thick glass (>6.85 mm): Attenuation > 1.0 -> (1 - ratio) < 0 -> Negative toe-in angle (dams ribbon)
*)
rKinematicNominalToe_deg := (1.0 - rAttenuationRatio) * 15.20 * (rGlassRibbonViscosity_LogP / 5.40);

(* Clamp nominal toe commands to physical gimbal mechanical hardstops *)
IF rKinematicNominalToe_deg > rToeLimitMax_deg THEN
    rKinematicNominalToe_deg := rToeLimitMax_deg;
ELSIF rKinematicNominalToe_deg < rToeLimitMin_deg THEN
    rKinematicNominalToe_deg := rToeLimitMin_deg;
END_IF;

(*
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SECTION 5: DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MPC PROFILE REGULATOR
  Cycle time Ts = 100 ms.
  State vector: x = [e_left (mm), e_right (mm), v_tin (m/s)]'
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
(* Measurement Pre-processing & Degradation Logic *)
IF bGaugeHealth_Left THEN
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_0100;
ELSE
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0100;
END_IF;

IF bGaugeHealth_Right THEN
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_0200;
ELSE
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0200;
END_IF;

IF bGaugeHealth_Left AND bGaugeHealth_Right THEN
    vecMeasurementResidual[1] := rThicknessSensor_Left_mm - rTargetNominalThickness_mm;
    vecMeasurementResidual[2] := rThicknessSensor_Right_mm - rTargetNominalThickness_mm;
    bDegradedControlMode      := FALSE;
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode     := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_0400;
ELSIF bGaugeHealth_Center THEN
    (* Fallback mode: Assume symmetrical distribution based on center sensor *)
    vecMeasurementResidual[1] := rThicknessSensor_Center_mm - rTargetNominalThickness_mm;
    vecMeasurementResidual[2] := rThicknessSensor_Center_mm - rTargetNominalThickness_mm;
    bDegradedControlMode      := TRUE;
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode     := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_0400;
ELSE
    (* Total optical loss: Lock innovations to zero *)
    vecMeasurementResidual[1] := vecStateEstimate[1];
    vecMeasurementResidual[2] := vecStateEstimate[2];
    bDegradedControlMode      := TRUE;
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode     := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0400;
END_IF;

(* Luenberger Observer Innovation Update: x_hat = x_hat + L * (y - C * x_hat) *)
vecStateEstimate[1] := vecStateEstimate[1] + (vecL[1] * (vecMeasurementResidual[1] - vecStateEstimate[1]));
vecStateEstimate[2] := vecStateEstimate[2] + (vecL[2] * (vecMeasurementResidual[2] - vecStateEstimate[2]));
vecStateEstimate[3] := vecStateEstimate[3] + (vecL[3] * 0.5 * ((vecMeasurementResidual[1] - vecStateEstimate[1]) + (vecMeasurementResidual[2] - vecStateEstimate[2])));

rProfileThicknessError_mm := (vecStateEstimate[1] + vecStateEstimate[2]) * 0.5;
rProfileAsymmetry_mm      := vecStateEstimate[1] - vecStateEstimate[2];

(* Diagnostics on tolerance exceedance *)
IF ABS(rProfileThicknessError_mm) > 0.85 THEN
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_1000;
ELSE
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_1000;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rProfileAsymmetry_mm) > 0.50 THEN
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_2000;
ELSE
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_2000;
END_IF;

(* MPC Analytical Unconstrained Quadratic Minimization *)
(* delta_toe_angle penalizes cross-directional thickness difference (wedge) *)
rRawDeltaToe := -(rCostWeight_Asymmetry * rProfileAsymmetry_mm) / (rCostWeight_AngleSlew + 65.0);

(* delta_speed penalizes mean thickness deviation *)
rRawDeltaSpeed := -(rCostWeight_Thickness * rProfileThicknessError_mm) / (rCostWeight_SpeedSlew + 45.0);

(* Apply Rate Slew Limiters to protect molten ribbon boundary from tearing *)
IF rRawDeltaToe > rMaxDeltaAngle_per_cycle THEN
    vecControlIncrement_MPC[1] := rMaxDeltaAngle_per_cycle;
ELSIF rRawDeltaToe < -rMaxDeltaAngle_per_cycle THEN
    vecControlIncrement_MPC[1] := -rMaxDeltaAngle_per_cycle;
ELSE
    vecControlIncrement_MPC[1] := rRawDeltaToe;
END_IF;

IF rRawDeltaSpeed > rMaxDeltaSpeed_per_cycle THEN
    vecControlIncrement_MPC[2] := rMaxDeltaSpeed_per_cycle;
ELSIF rRawDeltaSpeed < -rMaxDeltaSpeed_per_cycle THEN
    vecControlIncrement_MPC[2] := -rMaxDeltaSpeed_per_cycle;
ELSE
    vecControlIncrement_MPC[2] := rRawDeltaSpeed;
END_IF;

(* State-Space Time Update: x(k+1) = A * x(k) + B * u(k) *)
FOR idxRow := 1 TO 3 DO
    rAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR idxCol := 1 TO 3 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (matA[idxRow, idxCol] * vecStateEstimate[idxCol]);
    END_FOR;
    rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (matB[idxRow, 1] * vecControlIncrement_MPC[1]) + (matB[idxRow, 2] * vecControlIncrement_MPC[2]);
    vecPredictedState[idxRow] := rAccumulator;
END_FOR;

vecStateEstimate[1] := vecPredictedState[1];
vecStateEstimate[2] := vecPredictedState[2];
vecStateEstimate[3] := vecPredictedState[3];

(*
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SECTION 6: MULTI-STAGE CO-ORDINATED FINITE STATE MACHINE
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
CASE iOperationState OF
    0: (* STATE_00_COLD_INITIALIZATION: Matrix & Gain Register Configuration *)
        bFloatLineReady              := FALSE;
        bFailsafeRetractActive       := TRUE;
        rLIP_InverterFreqCmd_Hz      := 0.0;
        rLIP_CurrentSetpointCmd_A    := 0.0;
        rLeftRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg    := 0.0;
        rRightRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg   := 0.0;
        rLeftRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min := 0.0;
        rRightRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min:= 0.0;
        dwOperatingStatusWord        := 16#0000_0000;
        
        (* Discrete Transition Matrix A (Ts = 0.1s) *)
        matA[1,1] := 0.942; matA[1,2] := 0.038; matA[1,3] := -0.018;
        matA[2,1] := 0.038; matA[2,2] := 0.942; matA[2,3] := -0.018;
        matA[3,1] := 0.000; matA[3,2] := 0.000; matA[3,3] := 0.885;
        
        (* Control Input Coupling Matrix B *)
        matB[1,1] := -0.048; matB[1,2] := -0.035;
        matB[2,1] :=  0.048; matB[2,2] := -0.035;
        matB[3,1] :=  0.000; matB[3,2] :=  0.000;
        
        (* Luenberger Estimator Gain Vector L *)
        vecL[1] := 0.365;
        vecL[2] := 0.365;
        vecL[3] := 0.125;
        
        vecStateEstimate[1] := 0.0;
        vecStateEstimate[2] := 0.0;
        vecStateEstimate[3] := 0.0;
        
        IF bSupervisoryEnable AND bSafetyCircuitHealthy THEN
            iOperationState := 10; (* Advance to atmosphere validation *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_10_ATMOSPHERE_PURGE_STABILIZATION: Verify N2/H2 Positive Pressure & Bath Temp *)
        bFailsafeRetractActive := TRUE;
        dwOperatingStatusWord  := 16#0000_0010;
        
        (* Check thermal operating envelope: 780 to 1080 deg C *)
        IF (rMoltenTinCoreTemp_degC < 780.0) OR (rMoltenTinCoreTemp_degC > 1080.0) THEN
            dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0800;
        ELSE
            dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_0800;
        END_IF;
        
        (* Permissive to advance: Voted pressure > 3.2 mbar and tin temperature in range *)
        IF (rVotedBathPressure_mbar >= 3.20) AND ((dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND 16#0000_0800) = 0) THEN
            iOperationState := 20; (* Advance to linear induction pump warmup *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_20_TIN_DROSS_LIP_WARMUP: Soft-Start Linear Induction Pump to Clear Canal *)
        bFailsafeRetractActive  := TRUE;
        rLIP_InverterFreqCmd_Hz := 20.0; (* Baseline sweeping frequency [Hz] *)
        dwOperatingStatusWord   := 16#0000_0020;
        
        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#6S);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            IF bKnurlRollPermissive AND (rLehrDrawSpeed_m_min > 2.5) THEN
                iOperationState := 30; (* Advance to top-roll kinematic engagement *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_30_KNURL_ENGAGE_ALIGNMENT: Lower Knurl Wheels & Match Draw Velocity *)
        bFailsafeRetractActive := FALSE; (* Pneumatics lower knurled wheels onto ribbon edges *)
        dwOperatingStatusWord  := 16#0000_0030;
        
        (* Synchronize knurl surface velocity with Lehr draw speed *)
        rLeftRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min  := rLehrDrawSpeed_m_min * rBaseRollOverdrawRatio;
        rRightRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min := rLehrDrawSpeed_m_min * rBaseRollOverdrawRatio;
        
        (* Prescribe nominal kinematic toe angles based on product recipe thickness *)
        rLeftRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg  := rKinematicNominalToe_deg;
        rRightRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg := -rKinematicNominalToe_deg;
        
        tKnurlSlewTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4S);
        IF tKnurlSlewTimer.Q THEN
            tKnurlSlewTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iOperationState := 40; (* Enter active closed-loop multi-variable control *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_40_ACTIVE_MPC_CLOSED_LOOP: Active State-Space Model Predictive Regulation *)
        bFloatLineReady        := TRUE;
        bFailsafeRetractActive := FALSE;
        dwOperatingStatusWord  := 16#0000_0040;
        
        (* Superimpose MPC optimal corrections onto nominal kinematic baselines *)
        rLeftRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg  := rKinematicNominalToe_deg + vecControlIncrement_MPC[1];
        rRightRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg := -rKinematicNominalToe_deg - vecControlIncrement_MPC[1];
        
        rLeftRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min  := (rLehrDrawSpeed_m_min * rBaseRollOverdrawRatio) + vecControlIncrement_MPC[2];
        rRightRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min := (rLehrDrawSpeed_m_min * rBaseRollOverdrawRatio) + vecControlIncrement_MPC[2];
        
        (* Linear Induction Pump sweeping frequency adjusted based on radar dross depth *)
        rLIP_InverterFreqCmd_Hz := 20.0 + (rDrossCanalBedDepth_mm * 2.15);
        IF rLIP_InverterFreqCmd_Hz > 48.0 THEN
            rLIP_InverterFreqCmd_Hz := 48.0; (* Inverter frequency clamp *)
        END_IF;
        
        (* Monitor for sensor degradation *)
        IF bDegradedControlMode THEN
            iOperationState := 50; (* Transfer to degraded open-loop profile lock *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_50_DEGRADED_INSTRUMENTATION_HOLD: Failsafe Open-Loop Kinematic Hold *)
        bFloatLineReady        := TRUE;
        bFailsafeRetractActive := FALSE;
        dwOperatingStatusWord  := 16#0000_0050;
        
        (* Lock knurl toe angles strictly to nominal kinematic equation without MPC slew *)
        rLeftRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg  := rKinematicNominalToe_deg;
        rRightRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg := -rKinematicNominalToe_deg;
        
        rLeftRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min  := rLehrDrawSpeed_m_min * rBaseRollOverdrawRatio;
        rRightRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min := rLehrDrawSpeed_m_min * rBaseRollOverdrawRatio;
        
        rLIP_InverterFreqCmd_Hz := 22.0; (* Fixed conservative dross sweeping frequency *)
        
        (* Recover automatically if gauge integrity is restored *)
        IF NOT bDegradedControlMode THEN
            iOperationState := 40; (* Return to active MPC closed-loop profiling *)
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_99_FAILSAFE_EMERGENCY_RETRACTION: High-Speed Retraction & Inert Gas Flood *)
        bFloatLineReady              := FALSE;
        bFailsafeRetractActive       := TRUE; (* Retract cylinders to prevent hot glass jamming *)
        rLIP_InverterFreqCmd_Hz      := 0.0;
        rLIP_CurrentSetpointCmd_A    := 0.0;
        rLeftRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg    := 0.0;
        rRightRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg   := 0.0;
        rLeftRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min := 0.0;
        rRightRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min:= 0.0;
        dwOperatingStatusWord        := 16#0000_0099;
        
        (* Reset transition allowed only when safety circuit is healthy and enable cycled *)
        IF bSafetyCircuitHealthy AND NOT bSupervisoryEnable THEN
            iOperationState := 0;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
